comparison.statement: The prespecified low-Re contrast is Structural Boundary / Transitional Structure, whereas five of six primary high-Re samples are Structural Instability / Random Structure and one is Structural Boundary / Near-Critical Structure.

notes: The low-Re contrast does not invalidate the preregistered primary endpoint; it strengthens evidence that the recurrent high-Re instability regime is not a trivial consequence of the chamber or quantized P_SCALE construction.
The contrast consists of one prespecified snapshot and only 26 ladder values, so it is a structural contrast, not a population-level Reynolds-number law.
No monotonic Reynolds-number trend is claimed.

next_locked_step: Run all seven frozen P_SCALE ladders through canonical STRUC-PERC-I v2.5.0 with the generic adapter unchanged. Treat the percolation outcome as secondary/descriptive because the P_SCALE values are strongly quantized and the generic adapter deduplicates exact values.
